plan.title: AQ-OS Installer & Quick-Deploy Experience — golden path
plan.goal: One super-tuned, hardware-adaptive golden path (professional dev + gaming + OPTIONAL local AI) that takes a total beginner from bare machine to a working, beautiful workstation with no NixOS knowledge, loses nothing for experts, works fully offline (local-only, optional AI never on the install critical path), and proves guided/AI/manual build the identical system.
success_criteria: A first-time-Linux user reaches a working, tuned golden-path desktop with zero terminal, zero jargon, and one honest AI yes/no
Guided / AI / manual / legacy-flag inputs produce byte-identical canonical resolved plans AND equal Nix derivations (4-layer parity suite green)
Full install completes offline with no running model, coordinator, network, or account; AI is optional and off the install critical path
The only irreversible step (disk erase) is confirmed + backup-acknowledged; zero wrong-disk foot-guns; rollback is a headline feature on the non-destructive path
100% of expert flags/phases + direct-Nix workflows preserved (regression suite); local AI stack, when enabled, is tuned to the detected hardware

phases.name: P0 — Contract + inventory
phases.goal: the SSOT config schema + trusted resolver + mySystem field set + module catalog + deterministic hardware detector

phases.name: P1 — Golden-path guided flow (non-destructive)
phases.goal: the AQ-OS Workstation golden profile + guided TUI over the ACTIVE engine, no disk ops, parity tests green

phases.name: P2 — Local AI-assist (optional)
phases.goal: untrusted proposal adapter -> resolver -> semantic-diff approve; offline; hardware-fit model tuning

phases.name: P4 — Hardened bare-metal path
phases.goal: disko + resumable mutation journal + recovery media

phases.name: P5 — Aesthetics, ISO, one-command, library
phases.goal: theme layer, bootable ISO, --recommended, expanded/shareable templates

items.name: aqos-install-plan-v1 schema
items.validation_goal: schema self-tests + fail-closed on unknown fields; independent PASS
items.editorial_note: SSOT structural contract per codex PRD section 5

items.name: trusted resolver/compiler
items.goal: single command: validate -> apply defaults + cross-field invariants -> canonical JSON -> executor + Nix projections; front-ends never re-implement defaults
items.validation_goal: resolver unit tests + canonicalization determinism; independent PASS
items.editorial_note: the piece that makes guided/AI/manual one engine

items.name: mySystem installer-owned field set
items.goal: formalize which mySystem.* options the installer owns/projects (SSOT nix/modules/core/options.nix) vs expert-only direct Nix
items.validation_goal: field-set doc + a test asserting projection coverage

items.name: deterministic hardware detector
items.goal: probe CPU/GPU/RAM -> redacted capability summary schema (no PII/secrets); feeds golden tuning + the AI recommended/limited/not-advised call
items.validation_goal: detector tests on fixture hardware profiles; secret-free assertion
items.editorial_note: automates the manual RAM/GPU/model tuning we've done all session

items.name: module catalog + metadata
items.goal: catalog profiles/roles/options with label/cost/deps/conflicts metadata the installer consumes
items.validation_goal: catalog completeness test vs actual modules
items.editorial_note: good candidate for a bounded local slice-prep task

items.name: AQ-OS Workstation golden profile
items.goal: new nix/modules/profiles golden profile: pro dev + gaming + optional-AI toggle, hardware-tuned defaults
items.validation_goal: builds green across hardware fixtures; AI-off path has no AI deps
items.editorial_note: the blessed default; a curated resolved plan over the modular engine

items.name: guided TUI over active engine
items.goal: welcome -> confirm hardware-tuned golden defaults -> optional-AI yes/no (hardware-honest) -> preview exact mutations -> authorize -> rebuild/switch with durable progress; NO disk ops
items.editorial_note: thin layer emitting resolved-plan into the ACTIVE nixos-quick-deploy.sh, never a fork

items.name: guided/manual parity suite (4 layers)
items.goal: adapter + projection + Nix-eval parity tests: guided/AI/manual/legacy-flags -> byte-identical resolved plan + equal drvPaths
items.validation_goal: parity suite green on the golden scenarios; independent PASS

items.name: local AI proposal adapter
items.goal: untrusted adapter: redacted hw summary + choice catalog -> strict schema JSON; resolver renders; semantic-diff approve; offline local inference only
items.validation_goal: adapter rejects raw Nix/shell/secrets/disk-auth; approve-trusted-plan test
